stem:
A machine dispenses coffee into cups. The volume, $V$ cm$^3$, of coffee in a cup was measured for a random sample of 150 cups. The results were summarised as follows.

$$\sum v = 46\,350 \qquad \sum v^2 = 14\,410\,800$$

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Calculate unbiased estimates of the population mean, $\mu$, and population variance, $\sigma^2$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Another random sample of $n$ cups of coffee is taken, where $100 < n < 120$. A 95% confidence interval for $\mu$ is calculated using this sample. You may assume that, for large samples, unbiased estimates of $\sigma^2$ are very similar.
parts.text: Without calculation, state whether this confidence interval would be wider or narrower than the confidence interval found in part **(a)(ii)**. Give a reason for your answer.
